text.content:
A free city on the Del Coronado Bay, built on a dream and sold off in pieces.

Region: North California coast; an international Free City since the Arvin Accord of 2070
Controlled by: The City Council and Mayor Lucius Rhyne, in practice the megacorps, Arasaka above all
Feel: Gleaming towers, crumbling megabuildings, and a war zone a few blocks either way

Richard Night planned Coronado City as a safe, self-sufficient model of enlightened capitalism, building on cheap land after a massacre in Morro Bay and bringing in corporations to help finance it. He was shot dead in his penthouse on September 20, 1998; the killer was never caught, the city was renamed for him, and the mob moved in.

The megacorps broke the mob by 2011 and ran the city through a puppet mayor. The 4th Corporate War ended here in 2023 with a nuclear blast that destroyed Arasaka Towers and the Corporate Center. Nomads helped rebuild it, the megacorps took their seats back on the Council, and by the 2060s Night City was a boomtown.

The Unification War brought NUSA troops to the outskirts in 2070. Councilman Lucius Rhyne asked Arasaka for help, an Arasaka supercarrier sailed into Coronado Bay, and the Arvin Accord made Night City a free city belonging to no nation. Rhyne became mayor; Arasaka came back in force.

Gig hooks

  • A councilor wants proof that Arasaka wrote the latest zoning law, before the vote.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.15

text.content:
Key dates of the Dark Future, as the Edgerunner's Handbook tells them (pp.4-6).

  • 1990: A coalition of agencies, the Gang of Four, takes over the US government in secret; states begin declaring themselves Free States.
  • 1993: The first nomad packs form, among them the Aldecaldos.
  • 1994-1996: The world stock market crashes and the United States collapses.
  • 1998: Richard Night is murdered; Coronado City becomes Night City.
  • 2004-2006: The 1st Corporate War.
  • 2008-2010: The 2nd Corporate War, between SovOil and Petrochem.
  • 2013: The Soulkiller program is developed; a Johnny Silverhand concert ends in a riot.
  • 2016: The 3rd Corporate War, fought on the Net.
  • 2022: Rache Bartmoss dies and the DataKrash is released; the 4th Corporate War begins.
  • 2023: A nuclear blast destroys Arasaka's Night City towers; Militech is nationalized; the Time of the Red begins.
  • 2025: The 4th Corporate War ends; Netwatch declares the Net down.
  • 2030: Night City's reconstruction begins; Ziggurat builds the first CitiNet.
  • 2040: The first megabuildings go up in Night City.
  • 2044: Netwatch begins building the Blackwall.
  • 2053: The New United States constitution is ratified.
  • 2065: Rosalind Myers becomes President of the NUSA.
  • 2067: The Mox form after Lizzie Borden's murder.
  • 2069: The Unification War begins.
  • 2070: Arasaka's supercarrier arrives; the Arvin Accord ends the war and makes Night City a free city.
  • 2072: The Voodoo Boys drive an NCPD task force out of Pacifica.
  • 2076: An Arasaka and Militech incident damages the Corporate Center; rumor names David Martinez.
